'''Thorin Rist''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who was a member of [[House Rist]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], he planned on eliminating a group of House Organa nobles. His plan was foiled when he and his squad were defeated by a Republic spacer.
